BiblicalUsage: The word is the trumpet blast, the instrument itself. Ezekiel says they have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready, but none goeth to the battle, for God's wrath is upon all the multitude.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that a trumpet with no one marching is a picture of a people who heard the alarm and stayed home.
